channel_history_date_policy.snapshot_semantics: Pacific calendar date of the real Data API acquisition timestamp
channel_history_date_policy.analytics_semantics: official Pacific day returned by the Analytics API
channel_history_date_policy.legacy_policy: Back up, then physically delete Beijing, cutoff-time, 统计日期 and 记录日期 fields after verified backfill.
channel_history_date_policy.exact_timestamp_policy: Keep only real API acquisition timestamps in Pacific time; do not synthesize cutoff timestamps from date-only values.
channel_history_date_policy.missing_analytics_policy: Do not create a zero row when the API did not return video+day.
channel_history_date_policy.video_day_settlement_policy: Write a per-video day only when its detail total equals an independently queried control total over the exact same filtered video set.
